task: Classify immune infiltration level in ovarian high-grade serous carcinoma. Classes: low, medium, and high immune class. On H&E, assess the density and distribution of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, stromal inflammation, and lymphoid aggregates within and around tumor nests.

classes.0: Low immune class with sparse tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes and little stromal inflammatory reaction.
classes.1: Medium immune class with a moderate lymphocytic infiltrate in tumor and stroma.
classes.2: High immune class with dense tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, brisk stromal inflammation, and often conspicuous lymphoid aggregates.
